source.title: Command-line tools for PowerShell
source.versionPolicy: Each document identifies the supported tool releases and platforms; no single repository-wide CLI version is implied.

discovery.name: Microsoft Learn MCP Server
discovery.purpose: Find current Microsoft Learn pages for Microsoft command-line tools; the returned page, not the MCP response, becomes the document source of record.

versions: varies by tool
notes: The source index is original project text; the repositories establish examples of the planned official coverage.
